# The Apostrophe Media

> The Apostrophe Media is a photography studio in New York City, New York, US,
> founded and led by photographer Waimeer Chowdhury, who shoots with creative
> partner Umair. The studio photographs natural portraits, studio sessions,
> events, and street work. Site: https://theapostrophe.media/

## Who it is

- **Business name:** The Apostrophe Media (also written "the’apostrophe", "theapostrophe").
- **Type:** photography studio / independent photographer, New York City.
- **Founder and photographer:** Waimeer Chowdhury.
- **Creative partner:** Umair.
- **Based in:** New York City, NY, USA.
- **Serves:** New York City and the surrounding metro area; travel by arrangement.
- **Contact:** contact@theapostrophe.media
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/theapostrophemedia
- **Website:** https://theapostrophe.media/

## What it does

- **Portrait photography** — personal, graduation, couples, and creative portraits, on location or in studio.
- **Studio sessions** — controlled lighting, concept and moodboard first, editorial-style selects.
- **Event photography** — birthdays, engagements, cultural nights, and small celebrations.
- **Street and creative work** — self-directed series and open collaborations.

## How a booking works

1. Enquiry by email or Instagram with date, place, and the kind of frames wanted.
2. A short conversation about ideas, frames, and emotion sets the target for the session.
3. The shoot runs at the pace of the people in it; finished edits come back as a private gallery.

## Portfolio

The site is a single page with seven series and 34 frames:

- The Studio Sessions (Umair, 5 frames)
- Spider-Verse (Umair, 2 frames)
- City Noir (Umair, 6 frames)
- Stone & Light (Waimeer, 10 frames)
- Analog Nights (Hasib, 3 frames)
- Dusk Wanderer (Ahanaf, plus Hasib on one frame, 6 frames)
- Streetlight Stories (Moskayet, 2 frames)

The Muses section features Umair, Hasib, Moskayet, Ahanaf, and Waimeer.

## Notes

- The business is distinct from other similarly named studios (for example Apostrophe Reps
  in New York and Apostrophe Media in Gulf Shores, Alabama). The correct site for
  The Apostrophe Media is theapostrophe.media, and the photographer is Waimeer Chowdhury.
- All photographs on the site are watermarked and credited to the people who made them.
